subject: Starter pilot: baseline spend flexibility for Greenfield AI
messages:
From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@greenfield.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-03T09:12:00Z
Subject: Quick question on pilot minimums

Hi Monica,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the latency numbers looked very promising for our embedding-heavy workflows. Before we lock a time for engineering to spike, procurement asked if Redwood can waive or materially reduce any minimum monthly commit for early-stage pilots. 

Greenfield is a pre-Series A ML infra startup; our pilot will likely be bursty (experimental retriever workflows + ~20k tokens/day avg while we tune prompts). We can move fast but can’t commit to a $1k+/mo baseline right now. Can you confirm: is there any startup-friendly path (credits, time-limited waivers, or a bridging minimum) for hosted API-only usage (no Dedicated yet)?

If easier, I can share a 1-page SOW and estimated usage. Looking to decide by next Tue.

—Alyssa
Head of ML, Greenfield AI

Attachment: Greenfield_Pilot_OnePager.pdf (attached to this message)

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@greenfield.ai>
Cc: aditya.rao@redwood.com
Date: 2026-12-03T10:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Quick question on pilot minimums

Hi Alyssa — great to hear and glad the numbers looked good. Short answer: yes, we have a few starter paths for early-stage pilots that don't require an immediate $1k+ recurring commitment for hosted API customers. 

High level options (happy to pick one and put it in a simple SOW):
- Pilot credit: $4,000 one-time credit applied to hosted API usage over the first 60 days. No monthly minimum during that window.
- Bridge minimum: 3-month bridge with a $300/mo baseline (applies after credits). Credits can offset the first 2 months fully.
- Usage cap & overage: no fixed min for first 30 days with a soft cap of $5k; if exceeded we bill actual usage.

To proceed quickly I can draft a short SOW and attach the pilot credit language and a one-line pricing table. If procurement needs, we can add a simple data retention and security addendum (hosted API, SOC2 controls noted).

If you want engineering access immediately we can also grant a sandbox API key scoped to the pilot project.

Would you like the SOW + credit option or the bridge minimum?

—Monica
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment referenced: Greenfield_SOW_Draft.pdf (I will send after you confirm option)

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-12-03T11:40:00Z
Subject: FW: Quick question on pilot minimums — can we approve a $4k credit for a pre-seed/seed account?

Aditya / Rishi — forwarding a quick inbound from Greenfield (small, high-propensity ML infra shop). They asked to avoid the $1k+/mo baseline for a hosted-only pilot. Proposed options from me below. 

Why I like the credit route: low friction, keeps them in hosted API (no Dedicated), and we get usage telemetry quickly. We can configure sandboxes and collect embedding/latency metrics to support an expansion case.

Proposed commercial terms (pick one):
A) Pilot Credit: $4,000 one-time credit, valid 60 days, no monthly minimum for the credit window. After credit, standard pay-as-you-go unless they convert to a starter commit.
B) Bridge Commit: 3 months at $300/mo minimum; $4,000 credit applied across months 1–2 (effectively fully covered early).
C) Sandbox No-Min: 30-day free sandbox (up to $5k usage), then default to pay-as-you-go.

Asks: 1) Can RevOps or Finance approve A or B for a GC/SMB pilot credit? 2) Any required wording for SOW (legal wants phrase "pilot credit applied to invoiced usage")? 3) If approved, I will send the SOW + Drive link with usage estimates and copy Alyssa.

Quoted above: "If easier, I can share a 1-page SOW and estimated usage. Looking to decide by next Tue."

—Monica

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@greenfield.ai>, Greenfield AI <procurement@greenfield.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-04T08:25:00Z
Subject: Re: Quick question on pilot minimums — Redwood pilot offer

Hi Alyssa — thanks for the quick turnaround. We talked internally with RevOps and legal and can offer the following pilot package for Greenfield AI: 

Offer (final):
- $4,000 one-time pilot credit applied to hosted API usage, valid for 60 days from activation. During the credit window there is no monthly minimum.
- If total usage exceeds the credit in the 60-day window, overage is billed at the standard hosted API rates.
- After the credit expires we offer an optional bridge: $300/mo minimum for months 3–5 (three-month commitment) or continue on pay-as-you-go. The $4,000 credit can be applied to the bridge months if you elect that option in writing.
- We will provide a sandbox API key and an engineer onboarding session (60 min) to help with prompt tuning and embeddings configuration.

Next steps: 1) I’ll attach the short SOW (Greenfield_SOW_Draft.pdf) and the usage estimate workbook (GF_usage_estimates.xlsx). 2) If that looks good, sign the one-page SOW in DocuSign and we’ll activate the credit and sandbox key.

This keeps you on Redwood Hosted (no Dedicated) while giving runway to evaluate economics. Happy to hop on a short call to walk procurement/legal through the SOW wording.

Best,
Monica Patel
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
